statement.zh-TW: 計算現金流量允當比率時，如果今年的存貨比去年少，分母要把「存貨減少額」當成負數加進去，讓分母變小。
statement.en: When calculating the cash flow adequacy ratio, if inventories fell this year the decrease should be added to the denominator as a negative amount, making the denominator smaller.

feedbackTrue.zh-TW: 你注意到存貨的變動會影響分母，方向是對的。不過只有存貨增加才需要多投入現金；存貨減少時這一項以零計算，不拿它來縮小分母。
feedbackTrue.en: You noticed that the change in inventories affects the denominator, which is right. But only an increase needs extra cash; when inventories fall this item counts as zero and is not used to shrink the denominator.

feedbackFalse.zh-TW: 答對了。分母只計入「存貨增加額」；存貨減少表示不需要為存貨多投入現金，這一項當作零。
feedbackFalse.en: Correct. The denominator only includes the increase in inventories; a decrease means no extra cash was tied up in inventory, so the item counts as zero.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_35qb8and}}的分母是「需要現金的三件事」，{{term:tm_n7v3k8pq}}減少不是一件需要現金的事，所以只取增加額、減少時以零計。課程 Excel 的公式在存貨減少時會把分母縮小，網站計算課程 Excel 口徑時，存貨減少一律以零計。
explanation.en: The denominator of the {{term:tm_35qb8and}} lists three things that need cash. A fall in {{term:tm_n7v3k8pq}} is not a cash need, so only an increase is taken and a decrease counts as zero. The course Excel formula would shrink the denominator when inventories fall; on the course Excel basis the site counts a decrease as zero.
